import httpx
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI
llm = ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-4o-mini", api_key="sk-test", max_retries=0)
BODY = {"id":"x","object":"chat.completion","created":0,"model":"gpt-4o-mini","choices":[{"index":0,"finish_reason":"stop","message":{"role":"assistant","content":"pong"}}]}
def handler(req):
    assert req.url.path.endswith("/chat/completions")
    return httpx.Response(200, json=BODY)
c = llm.root_client._client
assert c.follow_redirects is True
c._transport = httpx.MockTransport(handler)
out = llm.invoke("ping")
assert out.content == "pong", out
print("OK", out.content)
